source_snapshot.items: Check GPU Libraries is suitable for rocFFT
source_snapshot.procedure: Build ROCm and rocFFT, then compile `fft1d.c` with `-lOpenCL -lclFFT` and run it.
source_snapshot.deepseek: PARTIAL proposes a generic rocFFT smoke/info test and omits the literal clFFT/OpenCL example.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: Identifies rocFFT versus clFFT/OpenCL API conflict and requires matching sources, transform definition, complex reference/tolerance and runtime linkage proof.

old_problem: Title/build require rocFFT, while the executable command links clFFT/OpenCL; these APIs, artifacts and support paths are distinct, and neither source defines transform input/size/direction/normalization or numerical tolerance.
disposition_reason: No approved rule can select rocFFT over the literal clFFT command or merge them. Library identity changes the code under test, while missing transform semantics are core Expected Result. Generic smoke output cannot resolve either. Project authority must choose/split coverage and provide a numerical oracle.
decision_basis: Directly read Compatibility row215 all18 XLSX cells and history2819.
Preserved rocFFT title/build and clFFT/OpenCL `fft1d.c` procedure as conflicting source evidence.
Required direction/normalization/complex tolerance and runtime linkage; no build or DUT action occurred.

test_case.test_name: GPU FFT suitability pending rocFFT versus clFFT/OpenCL scope decision
test_case.purpose: After project authority selects or splits the library scope, build and run the matching FFT example against the intended artifact and prove numerically correct transform output with known direction and normalization.
required_package: Authoritative decision: rocFFT, literal clFFT/OpenCL `fft1d.c`, or separate variants
Pinned matching ROCm/library sources/packages, revisions and checksums
Approved transform input, length/dimensions, direction, batch/stride and normalization
Complex reference output and absolute/relative tolerance
Compiler/linker/runtime library manifest, stable GPU target and isolated cleanup
test_case.test_command: Do not compile while library identity is unresolved. For the approved branch, build the pinned matching library/example, record compiler/link trace and loaded-library hashes, execute the exact approved transform on the stable GPU target, and compare every complex output with its direction/normalization-aware reference and tolerance. A rocFFT info/smoke command cannot pass clFFT coverage or vice versa.
test_case.expected_result: The selected example loads only the intended library, runs on the mapped GPU and produces the complete complex transform within approved tolerance and normalization, with no loader, GPU or platform error.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires authoritative library identity, matching API/example, proven runtime linkage and an approved numerical FFT oracle. Process exit or visually plausible output cannot pass.
safety_gate: Use isolated build/runtime paths and do not alter global loader configuration.
Pin target by UUID/BDF and control workload input/size to approved bounds.
Verify loaded shared objects before accepting output.
Abort on unintended library resolution, numerical mismatch, GPU/XID or resource fault; clean isolated artifacts and do not retry automatically.
expected_evidence: Pinned source/package checksums and build manifest
Compiler/link trace and runtime library paths/hashes
Complete complex output comparison, GPU/kernel logs and cleanup
test_case.recovery: Terminate the example, remove only isolated artifacts/environment, preserve build/link/output/log evidence and restore the prior environment. Escalate GPU or library faults without switching APIs or rerunning automatically.

source_conflict.reason: rocFFT title/build and clFFT/OpenCL compile/run remain materially different library/API coverage.
